生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use Riven's weapon exactly as shown in the provided reference.
Keep the weapon visually consistent throughout the entire video.
Do not redesign or alter the weapon.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
for the dark figure.

Use the provided Father reference
only for Riven's brief memory.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

The present scene continues inside
the damaged burning wooden building.

Maintain the same fire, smoke,
broken wood, ash, and debris.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Restrained emotional performance.

Natural physical movement.

Cinematic but controlled camera movement.

Natural fire, distant destruction,
heavy breathing, footsteps,
wood creaking, and environmental sound.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No magical activation.

No glowing runes.

No heroic power-up.

Only Father's memory voice is heard.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven remains exhausted
inside the damaged burning building.

The painful memories from the previous scene
begin to change.

Instead of remembering only what she lost,
Riven remembers why she once chose to fight.

Her father's words return:

"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."

Back in the present,
Riven notices civilians still escaping
from the burning settlement behind her.

They are still alive.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
remains ahead of her.

Riven realizes there are still people
she can protect.

Despite her injuries and exhaustion,
she chooses to stand again.

No power-up.

She simply refuses to remain down.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — WHY SHE FOUGHT ===

OPEN IMMEDIATELY
on a tight side close-up of Riven.

Do not recreate the exact ending composition
of the previous scene.

Riven remains low among the debris.

Her face is exhausted.

Her breathing is heavy.

Orange firelight flickers across her skin.

The background remains soft
and obscured by smoke.


The surrounding sound
slowly becomes distant and muffled.


Very brief memory fragments
return to Riven.


FLASH —

her father alive,
calm and strong.


FLASH —

a quiet memory of Riven
with her father before everything was lost.


FLASH —

her ally once standing beside her.


These memories are different
from the painful fragments before.

They are memories of the people
who gave meaning to her fight.


Over the final memory,

her father's voice returns clearly:


"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."


Hold briefly on Riven's reaction.


CUT BACK TO PRESENT.


=== SHOT 2 — PEOPLE STILL ALIVE ===

The sound of the burning settlement
slowly returns.


Fire.

Breaking wood.

Distant footsteps.


Then Riven hears frightened people
somewhere outside.


She turns her head
toward the broken opening in the building.


CUT to her point of view.


Beyond the damaged wall
and through the smoke,

a small number of civilians
are moving away from the burning settlement.


Some support each other
as they escape toward safety.


Keep them distant.

Do not turn this into a crowd scene.


CUT back to Riven.


She watches them.


A quiet realization.


They are still alive.


Riven slowly turns her attention
back toward the interior.


Through the smoke ahead,

the Mysterious Dark Figure
remains between the burning structures.


Riven looks toward it.


Then briefly back
toward the escaping civilians.


No dialogue.


Her expression changes subtly.

Not anger.

Not confidence.

Resolve.


=== SHOT 3 — STAND AGAIN ===

The Mysterious Dark Figure
begins slowly advancing toward Riven.


Riven looks down.


Her hand tightens
around her weapon.


No magical energy.

No glowing runes.

Nothing changes about the weapon.


Riven plants her free hand
against the ground.


Slowly—

she forces herself upward.


Her body is exhausted.

The movement is difficult.

She does not rise like a superhero.


She struggles—

then finally reaches her feet.


Riven steadies herself.


Ahead of her:

the Mysterious Dark Figure.


Behind her:

the distant civilians
continue escaping from the burning settlement.


Riven now stands between them.


She raises her weapon
into a simple defensive fighting stance.


She is still hurt.

Still exhausted.

Still physically outmatched.


But she does not move aside.


The Mysterious Dark Figure
slowly comes to a stop
across from her.


Riven holds her ground.


No dialogue.

No power-up.

No magical activation.


Hold on the confrontation.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven is standing again.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
is directly ahead of her.

Escaping civilians remain behind Riven.

Riven has deliberately placed herself
between the figure and the people.

Her weapon remains exactly consistent
with the provided reference.

There is still no magical energy
and no rune activation.

Riven has not gained new power.

She has simply chosen
to protect the people who are still alive.

CUT.、16:9
